classified.text: Patients shall be able to register an account, verify identity, and create a personal health profile.
The user shall be able to browse provider calendars and book an appointment for an available time slot.
System shall prevent double‑booking by enforcing exclusive reservation of selected slots.
Patients shall join a scheduled video consultation through a secure, time‑limited link.
Providers shall manage their availability, set working hours, and block out personal time.
Providers shall start, pause, and end video visits, with the system automatically recording session duration.
Provider shall issue an e‑prescription that is stored in the patient’s record and transmitted to a selected pharmacy.
Patients shall view e‑prescription details and download a PDF copy for personal records.
Both patients and providers shall access medical records, with patients receiving read‑only view rights and providers receiving edit rights where appropriate.
System shall generate and display a visit summary immediately after each consultation.
Patients shall be able to upload prior medical documents (e.g., lab results, imaging) to their profile.
Providers shall add clinical notes to the visit summary, which become part of the permanent medical record.
System shall calculate a billing invoice based on visit type, duration, and applicable insurance coverage.
Patients shall view outstanding invoices and complete payment through an integrated payment gateway.
System shall automatically submit an insurance claim after a visit, attaching required CPT and diagnosis codes.
Providers shall receive real‑time notifications of claim status changes (accepted, rejected, pending).
An administrator shall configure and maintain mappings for insurance providers, reimbursement rates, and claim formats.
System shall send automated email and SMS reminders to patients 24 hours before their appointment.
CareConnect shall achieve 99.9 % availability across all deployed regions, providing continuous access to telehealth services.
All protected health information (PHI) shall be encrypted at rest using AES‑256 and in transit using TLS 1.3.
The platform shall enforce role‑based access control (RBAC) to restrict functions to authorized patient, provider, and administrator roles.
System shall maintain immutable audit logs for every access to medical records and retain them for a minimum of seven years.
CareConnect shall scale horizontally to support up to 100 000 concurrent video consultation sessions without degradation.
The response time for booking an appointment shall not exceed two seconds under normal load conditions.
System shall be deployable through automated CI/CD pipelines and run in container orchestration platforms such as Kubernetes.
The platform shall expose health‑check endpoints and emit operational metrics to Prometheus for real‑time observability.
